_설명: 재미나이 앱(구독 · gemini.google.com 음악 만들기)으로 뽑을 배경음악 주문서 — 형 지시 「배경음악과 효과음 등 소리도 재미나이에서 뽑아서」(2026-10-11). 유료 API 키는 쓰지 않는다. 받은 파일은 tool/audio/gen/<id>.(mp3|wav) 로 두고 올리면, 클라우드가 반복 이음매·음량을 맞춰 OGG 로 넣는다.
common: Instrumental only, no vocals, no lyrics. Traditional Korean/East-Asian wuxia martial-arts game soundtrack using gayageum, geomungo, daegeum, haegeum, taepyeongso, janggu, buk drum, jing gong and kkwaenggwari. Clean modern game mix, punchy but not muddy, suitable as a seamless looping background track for a mobile game.

tracks.prompt: Calm, warm and welcoming main-menu theme. Daegeum flute sings the melody, gayageum answers, light janggu in a relaxed 12/8 semachi rhythm, around 90 BPM, hopeful mood of a young hero leaving the mountain village.
Bright, light and playful village-yard battle theme. Gayageum sanjo-style plucking leads, bouncy janggu, cheerful and easy-going, about 100 BPM, beginner-friendly energy.
Rowdy, comical tavern brawl theme. Haegeum slides mischievously, gayageum plays along, fast jajinmori rhythm on janggu and small buk hits, about 120 BPM, slapstick fun.
Festive market-street fight. Kkwaenggwari, janggu and buk drive a whirling hwimori rhythm, taepyeongso calls out loudly over the crowd, about 140 BPM, exciting festival chaos.
Mysterious deep-forest duel. Breathy daegeum with deep vibrato and bends wandering through mist, sparse slow jungmori rhythm, low drones, about 80 BPM, tense but beautiful.
Dignified scholar-hall battle of wits. Geomungo leads with deep, weighty plucks, gayageum answers in counterpoint, steady stately pulse never stopping, about 90 BPM, intelligent and solemn.
Grand championship finale on a frozen arena. Thundering buk, jing and kkwaenggwari in fast hwimori, majestic taepyeongso and haegeum melody, about 150 BPM, epic and heroic.
Intense rival boss battle. Aggressive scraping haegeum in a dark minor gyemyeon mode, relentless buk drums pushing forward, sudden jing hits, about 145 BPM, dangerous and urgent.
Short, extremely tense inner-energy duel cue. Heartbeat-like buk double hits accelerating, rising tremolo haegeum and low drone swelling, then a frantic climax, about 160 BPM, nail-biting suspense.
